intuition: A max-heap returns the task with highest priority and largest task ID, while a map stores current task state.

brute_force.approach: Scan every task for execution and linearly search tasks for edits or removals.
brute_force.time: add O(1), edit O(n), rmv O(n), execTop O(n)

optimal.approach: Use a task map and a heap of priority records; lazy validation skips heap entries invalidated by edits or removals.
optimal.time: add O(log n), edit O(log n), rmv O(1), execTop O(log n) amortized

edge_cases: Equal priorities are ordered by descending task ID.
Removed and edited heap records are ignored when they reach the top.
